title: Keep archived coverage recoverable and visible
description: Keep archived coverage recoverable and visible
acceptance_criteria: An archived change with a generated coverage receipt can reopen and re-finalize using current coverage. A refused or interrupted reopen preserves the archived package and unexpected files. Status, show and audit --archives report a present invalid coverage receipt, while legitimately absent receipts remain silent and authenticated archive evidence stays valid.

answers.constraints: REQ-change-162 uses the confined durable transaction journal and restores original bytes on publication failure. REQ-change-165 confines project reads and writes. REQ-change-167 keeps the archive evidence independent of optional coverage. The command adapter renders domain diagnostics in text and JSON.
